description: This file defines a CKEditor dialog for managing 'select' HTML elements, including options and their properties, with functions for adding, removing, and modifying options within the dialog interface.

methods.name: b
methods.description: Creates and adds an 'OPTION' element to a select element, setting its text and value.

methods.name: c
methods.description: Removes all 'OPTION' children from a select element and resets selection.

methods.name: d
methods.description: Modifies the text and value of an existing option at a specified index.

methods.name: e
methods.description: Removes all child elements from a given node.

methods.name: f
methods.description: Moves an option up or down within the options list.

methods.name: g
methods.description: Returns the index of the selected option.

methods.name: h
methods.description: Sets the selected index of a select element.

methods.name: i
methods.description: Returns the children of a node, typically options.

methods.name: j
methods.description: Retrieves the input element from a node.
